label: Seeded sample faults. These are written for the benchmark. They are not measurements from a plant. heldOut true means the symptom was written so the catalog word-match does not already land on the expected equipment and failure. Those labels were set before the model run.

cases.symptom: Centrifugal pump mechanical seal is leaking at the weep hole. Product is on the baseplate and the seal faces look scored. Vibration is steady.
Induction motor bearing noise started after the last grease round was skipped. The housing is warm and the noise tracks shaft speed.
Belt conveyor is mistracking. The belt walks off the tail pulley toward the structure within a minute of start.
Compressor high discharge temp alarm. The intercooler face is fouled and the discharge temperature climbs under load.
Control valve stiction. The stem sticks between 40% and 60% while the positioner output keeps moving.
Shell and tube heat exchanger tube leak. Process product is showing up in the cooling-water return.
Boiler low water alarm. The sight glass is empty and the burner has tripped.
MCC panel breaker trip on the pump starter. The cubicle smells hot and the breaker will not stay closed.
Gearbox mesh howl at tooth-pass on the output set.
Pressure transmitter frozen reading. The value has not moved for an hour while the local gauge beside it still swings.
Isolation valve seized shut. Operations cannot get it off the seat.
Fire and gas detector false alarm overnight. A bump with air did not repeat the horn.
Product is dripping off the shaft end of the process machine onto the skid. The faces look glazed. Suction sounds normal and flow is steady.
The 75 kW driver growls once per revolution and the housing is too hot to hold after a missed grease round.
The troughed rubber band climbs the side frame a minute after start and rubs the steel stringer.
The air-end outlet climbs past the alarm and the cooler fins are packed with dust. It is not swinging into surge.
The pneumatic globe on the level loop moves in jumps. The air signal keeps changing but the stem waits, then jumps.
Cooling water returning to the tower has product in it. The bundle was cleaned last year and the approach has opened up.
The sight on the steam raiser reads empty and firing has dropped out while the feed set keeps pushing.
The starter cubicle for the charge machine popped and will not reset. There is a burnt smell and a brown mark on one lug.
